fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates market ${accounts.market} with base token ${accounts.baseMint} and quote token ${accounts.quoteMint}

docs: What the program reads after the base token program, each only when present and told apart by owner or address: the base mint (a Token-2022 base), the quote token program (when it differs from the base's), the quote mint (a Token-2022 quote), then a global account and its vault, when the market's orders draw on one. Their places vary, so they cannot be named one by one.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} swaps at most ${data.params.inAtoms} for ${data.params.outAtoms} on market ${accounts.market}, the output being a minimum when the input is exact

arguments.name: freeBlocksRequired
docs: Free blocks the market must have after the call; read only when present. Without it the program makes sure of two.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} pays the rent to expand market ${accounts.market}

docs: Up to two groups of five accounts, one per side whose global orders the batch touches, base or quote in either order: the side's mint, its global account, the global vault, the market's vault for that mint and the mint's token program. Which side comes first is not fixed, so they cannot be named one by one.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} cancels and places the orders listed below on market ${accounts.market}
${accounts.payer} takes a trader seat on global account ${accounts.global}, paying a seat fee in SOL
${accounts.payer} deposits ${data.params.amountAtoms} of ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.traderToken} into global account ${accounts.global}
${accounts.payer} withdraws ${data.params.amountAtoms} of ${accounts.mint} from global account ${accounts.global} to ${accounts.traderToken}

${accounts.payer} evicts the owner of ${accounts.evicteeToken} from global account ${accounts.global}, returning their balance to that token account, and deposits ${data.params.amountAtoms} of ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.traderToken}, which must be more than that balance
${accounts.payer} removes the expired or unbacked order at index ${data.params.orderIndex} from market ${accounts.market}

docs: What the program reads after the base token program, each only when present and told apart by owner or address: the base mint (a Token-2022 base), the quote token program (when it differs from the base's), the quote mint (a Token-2022 quote), then a global account and its vault, when the market's orders draw on one. Their places vary, so they cannot be named one by one.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} swaps at most ${data.params.inAtoms} for ${data.params.outAtoms} on market ${accounts.market}, the output being a minimum when the input is exact

arguments.name: relocationBudget
docs: Most order and seat relocations to make; read only when present, and unbounded when absent. Zero relocates nothing.

arguments.name: seatBudget
docs: Most empty seats to reclaim; read only when present, and every empty seat when absent. Zero reclaims none.

arguments.name: retireIfEmpty
docs: Nonzero permits closing the market and its vaults when compaction leaves it empty; read only when present.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.collector} compacts market ${accounts.market} within the budgets shown and collects its excess rent

display.label: Last Valid Slot (0 = no expiry; spread for reverse orders)
